title: Llama.cpp — What it is
description: llama.cpp (by Georgi Gerganov) proved LLMs can run anywhere: a dependency-light C/C++ engine that executes quantized GGUF models on CPU, Metal and CUDA with startling speed. llama-cli chats and benchmarks, llama-server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, and the quantize tool squeezes 70B models into consumer VRAM (Q4_K_M and friends). It is the engine under countless local-AI apps. It is made by Georgi Gerganov et al. and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile.
